name: Meeting Prep
summary: What do I need before the next meeting?
description: Shows the next meeting and what you need before it starts: the upcoming timeline, the next event's title, the notes you flagged and a prep checklist. Reads only the calendar bridge's next-event metadata and the checklist in your own meeting notes; it never invents attendees, agenda items or links.
highlights: The next event and the timeline that follows
A prep checklist drawn from your meeting notes
Never invents attendees or agenda items
